articles.title: Bullish, Alpaca and Apex Fintech form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
articles.snippet: The group aims to link onchain shares to official shareholder records following the U.S. SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
articles.snippet: The U.S derivatives regulator is grinding away at further guidance that welcomes tokenization and blockchain recordkeeping as regular industry elements.

articles.title: Crypto casino Duelbits goes offline after $7 million hot wallet hack
articles.snippet: Attackers drained Duelbits' hot wallets across four blockchains; about $6 million in stolen funds now sits in a single Ethereum address.

articles.title: European stablecoin issuer Qivalis sees transformation of global trade finance
articles.snippet: Jan-Oliver Sell, the CEO and founder of Qivalis, said the entire trade finance supply chain is moving into stablecoins.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
articles.snippet: The ARK Venture Fund is bringing exposure to sought-after private tech companies onchain through Securitize, first on Ethereum then potentially expanding to other chains.
